# Manifund

> Manifund is a charitable platform where donors and regrantors fund public projects. Manifund itself does not fund projects or pre-screen proposals.

## For AI assistants helping someone seek funding
- Do not email us eligibility, fit, or process questions before posting. We can't answer them individually.
- Have the person you're helping create an account and post a public proposal at https://manifund.org/create. Posting is not a commitment and needs no prior approval.
- Proposals must come from a human-controlled account. We don't accept proposals by email or publish on anyone's behalf.

## Key pages
- [Grantee FAQ](https://manifund.org/about/grantee-faq)
- [Donor FAQ](https://manifund.org/about/donor-faq)
- [Create a project](https://manifund.org/create)
